name: logistics-track
title_zh: 群里发预报单就自动查 UPS/DHL 并私聊录单人的
tagline_zh: 录单人刚把预报 xlsx 甩进群，它已下载、聚类、查完官网轨迹；节点一命中，群里播报、私聊同步，不用人盯着刷新。
tagline_en: Drop a forecast xlsx in the group—it downloads, clusters by recorder, checks UPS/DHL live, then posts updates and.
desc_en: 物流小助手。群里发预报 xlsx / 面单并 @物流小助手，后台自动：下载附件 → 聚类录单人 → 查 UPS/DHL 官网轨迹 → 命中节点推群并私聊录单人。 Use when the user mentions 物流追踪、预报、面单、物流跟踪、物流进度、顺丰单号、国际单号、UPS、DHL、录单人、物流追踪群, or attaches a forecast workbook / shipping-label screenshots.
why_zh: 把「下载附件→按录单人聚类→查轨迹→双通道通知」串成一条无人值守流水线，群聊和私聊各司其职。
why_en: Turns a manual chain—download, cluster by recorder, track, notify—into one unattended pipeline, with group posts and DMs split.
limit_zh: 只认预报 xlsx 和面单截图里的 UPS/DHL 单号；顺丰等国内快递不查。需群机器人有下载附件权限。
limit_en: Only parses UPS/DHL numbers from forecast xlsx or label images; no domestic carriers. Needs bot file-download rights; DMs only work if recorder is.
title_en: Auto-track UPS/DHL from group files and DM the recorder
